answer: Track where registration funds came from and cap fan-out: one funding source may seed at most 3 identities, and a descendant wallet inherits its parent's counter. To spawn a tenth fake, an attacker must build a ridge of intermediate funded wallets, each needing aged, verified history, and every hop taints the chain further. A knoll of clones around one source stays small, while an honest oasis of unrelated funders is untouched.
